messages:
maria: heads up, chaos-probe canary failed in eu-west during the DB migration test.
kevin: saw it too. deploy-bot flagged health checks ~30s after probe started.
deploy-bot: Canary 81423: health-check fail - liveness probe 503 x3. Marking canary as UNHEALTHY. (link: https://deploy.redwood/example)
olivia: what exact failure? logs?
kevin: logs show `upstream_read` spikes and `pg_migration` job timed out. snippet:
```
2026-03-19T12:03:45Z ERROR migration: timeout waiting for lock
```
maria: this was the chaos probe (network-delay) run. we intentionally injected latency. can we fallback to stable chart v2.3.1 without migration?
raj: current chart is v2.4.0-incubator with migration hook. rollback to v2.3.1 should skip migration hook, but we need to pin values for new feature flags.
kevin: agree. propose manual pin + skip promotion to global pool. also update release notes saying we aborted migration under chaos.
maria: +1. change window open until 16:00 UTC today, we've got time for manual pin.
olivia: oncall? any objection to rollback/pin during window?
sre-oncall: ok from SRE if it's manual and we monitor for 30m after. add a safety annotation to the chart to prevent automatic retrigger.
kevin: steps:
1) `helm rollback prod 81423 --namespace=main` (pin to v2.3.1)
2) add annotation `redwood/auto-promote: \"false\"`
3) disable migration hook: `helm upgrade --set migration.enabled=false`
4) post-checks: /health, tail logs, run smoke user journey
maria: i'll run the rollback and post logs.
maria: (running) `helm rollback prod 81423` ...
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id jb-5567). ETA 2m.
maria: rollback finished, services back to green. tail shows no migration job triggered.
kevin: confirm: no DB schema changes applied?
maria: confirmed, migration job not executed. DB schema remains v1.
olivia: filing release note draft: "Canary aborted under chaos-probe; rolled back to stable chart v2.3.1, migration postponed. Reason: network chaos induced latency causing migration lock timeouts." Will add follow-up ticket to re-run migration after stabilizing.
raj: ticket RT-3421 created: https://jira.redwood/RT-3421
sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m, setting alert threshold lower. ping if error > 5% latency.
maria: closing thread. will update release notes and release-manager channel.
